target.title: fix: correct Poe provider logo and brand color
target.body:
## Problem

The Poe logo looked off on [codexbar.app](https://codexbar.app/?lang=en). The SVG contained a garbled path — a self-intersecting scribble inside a circle — instead of the actual Poe speech-bubble mark. Since the site renders provider logos as a CSS mask, that broken shape is what showed on the page. The brand color was also wrong: green `#26AD61` instead of Poe's official purple.

## Changes

- **`docs/logos/poe.svg`** — replace the garbled path with the correct Poe mark (speech bubble with two eyes), fill `#5D5CDE`
- **`Sources/CodexBar/Resources/ProviderIcon-poe.svg`** — same path fix for the macOS app's menu-bar/preferences icon (keeps `fill="currentColor"`), so app and website match
- **`docs/index.html`** — update the Poe card `--brand` hover color `#26AD61` → `#5D5CDE`

`#5D5CDE` is Poe's official primary brand color ("Poe purple") per [Poe's brand guidelines](https://poe.com/pages/brand-guidelines). The replacement artwork is the canonical Poe icon from lobehub/lobe-icons — the same library the repo's other provider logos come from.

## Verification

- Served `docs/` locally and confirmed the corrected mark renders at rest (page-text color) and tints toward Poe purple on hover, consistent with every other provider card.
- No other references to the old color or logo remain in the repo.
